additional_identity_fields.principal_epoch: inspectable substitution-resistant principal generation; distinct from allocation epoch
additional_identity_fields.principal_id: inspectable exact principal identity; digest-bound and never substitutes for principal_binding_digest

allocation_record.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=true, finite JSON numbers only; closed schemas reject unknown/missing fields, duplicate JSON keys, aliases, wildcards, booleans where integers are required, and mutable post-issuance changes.

field_rules.allocation_digest: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON over every required field except allocation_id and allocation_digest
field_rules.allocation_id: lmalloc- plus first 24 lowercase hex characters of allocation_digest; recomputed, never caller selected
field_rules.epoch: positive allocator-controlled monotonic allocation-policy generation, not principal epoch or serving activation generation
field_rules.policy_digest: lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the exact immutable allocator policy snapshot
field_rules.principal_binding_digest: exact verified CausalResourcePrincipal binding_digest lowercase sha256 hex
field_rules.resource_kind: exact literal governed_local_model_invocation_call_entitlement.v1; no aliases or wildcard
field_rules.resource_specific_bounds: exact closed v1 object defined below
field_rules.validity: exact closed object {not_before,not_after,principal_currentness_checked_at,principal_currentness_valid_until,allocator_policy_valid_until}; canonical UTC timestamps ending Z

allocation_record.name: GovernedLocalModelResourceAllocation

allocator_identity.allocation_epoch: monotonic positive policy generation controlled by this allocator; rollover never alters principal_epoch or serving activation generation
allocator_identity.meaning: stable resource-class allocator identity, not an authority principal and not caller supplied

attempt_semantics.attempt_id: lmattempt- plus 32 lowercase hex characters derived from SHA-256 of canonical JSON {allocation_digest, durable_attempt_nonce}; unique within and across correlations/restarts and durably uniqueness-checked before debit
attempt_semantics.backend_failure: Consumes one call if failure follows backend entry.
attempt_semantics.completion: The already consumed call remains consumed.
attempt_semantics.generation_begins: Consumes exactly one call once backend model generation entry begins.
attempt_semantics.pre_attempt_rejection: Consumes zero calls and writes no consumed receipt; a denied reservation may be audit evidence but cannot claim consumption.
attempt_semantics.retry: Every retry has a new attempt_id and needs another remaining call; prior receipts/debits remain visible. Correlation-ID rollover never replenishes.
attempt_semantics.serving_guard_rejection_after_debit: Reconcile as attempted_not_begun and restore the provisional debit only when trusted gate evidence proves backend entry did not occur.
attempt_semantics.timeout: Consumes one call if backend entry began; timeout/cancellation does not refund it.

candidate_task_authority_definition.purpose: Implement only the governed local-model invocation resource allocator, durable call-entitlement gate, and resource-consumption reconciliation defined by the frozen v1 contract; this definition grants no model effect authority.

conservation_semantics.call_unit_consumed_at: atomic durable debit at the final resource gate immediately before invoking the pre-effect serving-currentness guard and model generation; if that last serving guard rejects before model backend entry, reconciliation records attempted_not_begun and restores the debit because no effect attempt began
conservation_semantics.reservation: The atomic pre-attempt debit is the minimal reservation/debit; no separate reservation lifecycle or refundable currency is introduced.

not_truthful_today: proof that timed-out backend computation stopped
truthful_today: generation_attempted boolean inferred from backend-entry/effect evidence

current_source_semantics.effect_receipt: LocalModelInvocationReceipt reports effect attempt/output evidence, UTF-8 output bytes, latency, configured generation values, status, and admission reference; it is not a resource receipt.
current_source_semantics.max_calls_per_correlation: Checked and incremented in the invoker process-local invocation_counts map after effect admission and before submitting generation; it resets with process state and is a component safeguard, not a durable allocation ledger.
current_source_semantics.max_input_chars: The invoker compares Python len(prompt), i.e. Unicode code points despite the chars name; request semantic prompt_size separately uses UTF-8 bytes.
current_source_semantics.max_new_tokens: Passed as a configured generation maximum narrowed by LocalModelAuthorityRecord generation_ceilings; no exact actual-token count is returned or receipted.
current_source_semantics.max_output_chars: After generation completes, the invoker compares UTF-8 byte length and truncates encoded bytes to this value, decoding with errors ignored; the name says chars but enforcement unit is bytes and does not prevent generation compute.
current_source_semantics.timeout_seconds: Thread future wait ceiling, clamped to at least 0.001 seconds; timeout cancellation does not prove backend computation stopped.

execution_order: authenticated and current causal principal verification
allocation existence and structural verification plus early narrowing only
final current allocation validity check and atomic durable call debit
effect_admission_relationship.final_gate: after otherwise-valid effect admission and immediately before the serving pre-effect guard/model effect attempt; early inspection can narrow or block but never authorize

forbidden: automatically substitute another model without separate authorization

definition-only authority registration task completed without exercising authority
durable atomic call ledger and attempt uniqueness before effect attempt
integration retaining independent effect admission and serving-currentness gates

next_runtime_slice.requires: independent operator approval evidence bound to candidate_definition_digest

policy_binding.policy_digest: SHA-256 lowercase hex of the immutable closed allocator policy snapshot encoded with the allocation canonical JSON rules

issuance_requires: principal-specific currentness evidence from the exact bounded revocation snapshot
exact principal_id, principal_epoch, and principal_binding_digest cross-binding

receipt_contract.effect_receipt_digest: nullable until effect receipt exists; reconciliation appends a new hash-linked receipt cross-linking exact LocalModelInvocationReceipt.receipt_digest

measurement_rules.call_units_consumed: 0 before backend entry; exactly 1 once entry begins

receipt_contract.name: GovernedLocalModelResourceConsumptionReceipt
receipt_contract.previous_receipt_digest: null only for first receipt for attempt; later state appends exact predecessor digest
receipt_contract.receipt_digest: SHA-256 of canonical closed receipt JSON excluding receipt_id and receipt_digest; receipt_id is lmresrec- plus first 24 digest hex

resource_specific_bounds.comparison_rules: All values must be finite and positive; integer dimensions reject bool. Effective value for each dimension is numeric minimum(allocation bound, caller-requested bound, applicable model/serving ceiling). Missing caller narrowing means allocation value; a missing applicable model ceiling contributes no additional bound. Any caller or model value above allocation cannot expand it and is rejected or reduced to the minimum.

max_calls_per_correlation.actual_measurement: one durable call debit when the final gate commits immediately before generation attempt begins
max_calls_per_correlation.unit: generation attempts across the allocation, notwithstanding legacy correlation-scoped name

max_input_chars.unit: Python Unicode code points under current runtime

max_new_tokens.actual_measurement: currently unmeasurable as actual token consumption

max_output_chars.actual_measurement: generated output UTF-8 byte count is receiptable; returned output is post-generation truncated
max_output_chars.unit: UTF-8 bytes under current runtime despite field name

timeout_seconds.actual_measurement: invoker latency_ms is observable elapsed latency, not fungible debited currency or proof backend stopped

retry_and_restart_semantics.current_invocation_counts: process-local component safeguard only; not a ledger, durable consumption, allocation evidence, or restart-safe conservation
retry_and_restart_semantics.implementation_requirement: durable atomic attempt uniqueness, debit, remaining-call state, append-only receipt chain, and recovery/reconciliation must commit before backend entry
retry_and_restart_semantics.posture: durable cross-restart call conservation is required by v1 before activation

distinct_generations.allocation_epoch: allocator policy/allocation generation used for stale allocation rejection
distinct_generations.serving_activation_generation: operational model serving generation, independently checked and never copied into allocation epoch

validity_semantics.effective_not_after: min(allocation.not_after, principal.expires_at, principal-currentness snapshot valid_until, allocator policy valid_until, resource lease not_after if supplied)
validity_semantics.effective_not_before: max(allocation.not_before, principal.not_before if present, allocator policy not_before, resource lease not_before if a future policy supplies one)
validity_semantics.gate_rule: At issuance and final debit require effective_not_before <= now < effective_not_after and fresh re-verification against the exact authenticated principal and exact bounded currentness snapshot. Snapshot success is not live currentness after valid_until.
validity_semantics.resource_specific_lease: v1 adopts no additional lease window beyond explicit allocation validity.
validity_semantics.revocation: Principal or allocation revocation/supersession known to the durable gate blocks debit; no stale evidence fallback.
